instances.name: tri400tail
instances.description: Triangular lattice on a 400 x 400 torus (160,000 vertices, degree 6) with heavy-tailed weights 1-100: w = 1 + floor(100 u^3), so most edges are light and a few are heavy. Every triangle must leave one edge uncut: a frustrated antiferromagnet.

instances.name: dlat400
instances.description: Irregular frustrated lattice: the 400 x 400 triangular torus with 10% of its edges deleted at random, then extra edges up to 480,000 (80% to a random vertex within 4 rows and columns, 20% between two random vertices). Degrees vary (0-12); heavy-tailed weights 1-100 as in tri400tail.

instances.name: tri300s
instances.description: Signed triangular lattice on a 300 x 300 torus (90,000 vertices, degree 6): heavy-tailed magnitudes 1-100 as in tri400tail, and each edge negative with probability 1/2. A negative edge rewards keeping its two endpoints on the same side.

instances.name: tri200s4
instances.description: Signed triangular lattice on a 200 x 200 torus (40,000 vertices): magnitudes 1 + floor(100 u^4), heavier-tailed than tri300s (most edges very light, a few heavy), random signs.

instances.name: tri200g
instances.description: Triangular lattice on a 200 x 200 torus (40,000 vertices) with bell-shaped weights: each weight is the sum of four uniform draws in [-25, 25] (never 0), so about half are negative and most are small.

instances.name: vbg80k
instances.description: Random 3-regular graph on 80,000 vertices with the same bell-shaped signed weights as tri200g.
